question: A creature has the ability 'Whenever this creature becomes blocked by a white creature, destroy that creature at end of combat.' If it becomes blocked by a black creature that is later turned white, does the ability trigger?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the trigger event happened when the blocker was black, so the ability does not trigger.
expected.answer: A creature has the ability “Whenever this creature becomes blocked by a white creature, destroy that creature at end of combat.” If the creature becomes blocked by a black creature that is later turned white, the ability will not trigger.
